arStrings.szText: Increases Holy Bolt's Cast Speed by {c_number}[{SF_24}*100|%|]{/c} per stack.
{c_important}Holy Bolt{/c} deals {c_number}{payload:PAYLOAD_UPGRADE_A}{/c} damage and ricochets {c_number}[SF_15 - 1]{/c} times.

{c_important}Holy Bolt{/c} becomes a {c_important}Disciple{/c} Skill.

{c_important}Holy Bolt{/c} pierces, deals {c_number}{payload:PAYLOAD_SPEAR}{/c} damage, and applies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}.

{c_important}Holy Bolt{/c} becomes a {c_important}Justice{/c} Skill with a {if:SF_21}{c_number}{Cooldown Time}{/c}{else}{c_number}{SF_11}{/c}{/if} second Cooldown.

{c_important}Holy Bolt{/c} is hurled and smashes the ground, dealing {c_number}{payload:PAYLOAD_LOBBED}{/c} damage and Stunning enemies in an area for {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADE_C_STUN}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Holy Bolt{/c} Slows enemies by {c_number}[{SF_29} * 100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}[SF_30]{/c} seconds.

Increases {c_important}Holy Bolt{/c} Cast Speed by {c_number}[{SF_24}*100|%|]{/c} when hitting an enemy up to {c_number}[{SF_24}*100*{SF_25}|%|]{/c} times for {c_number}[SF_26]{/c} seconds.

Decreases {c_important}Holy Bolt's{/c} Cooldown by {c_number}[{SF_31}*100|%|]{/c}.
